/// A started job. Its result crosses back as a deep copy.
/// ```as
/// let job = Jobs.run(decodeTile, bytes);
/// let result = job.join();
/// if (result != null && result.ok) {
///     this.tile = result.value;
/// }
/// ```
export class Job<R> extends ResultLane<R> {
    /// Waits for the result. Null while the job is still running when the
    /// wait ends, which never outlasts this call's budget. A call without a
    /// budget runs a job no thread has started here, to its end; without
    /// pool threads, a job not run here runs at the next advance.
    join(): Settled<R>?;

    /// As join, waiting at most the given seconds for a job another thread
    /// is running.
    joinWithin(seconds: f64): Settled<R>?;

    /// As joinWithin for a result decoded into out, as peekInto decodes it;
    /// false too while the job is still running when the wait ends.
    @decodesInPlace
    joinInto(out: R, seconds: f64 = Infinity): bool;
}

/// Runs @job functions. Each job is named directly, so the compiler can find
/// it in the jobs module; its arguments are deep copied, except shared
/// memory, which the job reaches by id. A job has no time limit: it runs
/// until it returns or is stopped, and a stopped job is interrupted, on the
/// web only when it has fuel, which debug bakes and wasmFuel bakes give it. A
/// browser build without threads runs jobs on the page's thread, where one
/// with fuel fails once it passes the call budget.
export abstract class Jobs {
    /// Pool threads jobs may run on; 0 means every job runs on its joiner
    /// or at an advance.
    static threads(): u32;

    /// Runs an exported @job function on the pool, the arguments after it
    /// deep copied as its parameters. The compiler writes each call, so the
    /// job is named directly and Jobs.run is never taken as a value.
    /// ```as
    /// @job export function tile(map: TileMap, scale: f64): Tile {
    ///     return map.build(scale);
    /// }
    ///
    /// let job = Jobs.run(tile, map, 2.0);
    /// ```
    @builtin static run<R>(job: (...args: unknown[]) => R, ...args: unknown[]): Job<R>;

    /// The index of a job that is done, running one here as join would,
    /// and waiting up to the given seconds but never past this call's
    /// budget; -1 when every job is still running then.
    static joinAny<R>(jobs: Array<Job<R>>, seconds: f64 = Infinity): i32;
}
